zh:
浙江大学（Zhejiang University）成立于1897年，坐落于中国浙江省杭州市，是教育部直属、中央直管副部级建制的全国重点大学，位列国家“双一流”“985工程”“211工程”重点建设高校。学校下设30多个学院，涵盖哲学、经济学、法学、教育学、文学、历史学、理学、工学、农学、医学、管理学、艺术学等门类，在校生超6万人。
浙江大学在工程学、计算机科学、农学、临床医学、材料科学、化学、控制科学等领域实力雄厚，科研创新能力位居全国高校前列，培养了大批杰出人才。2026QS世界大学排名中，浙江大学位列世界第44位。
en:
Zhejiang University (ZJU) is a top national research university located in Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province, China. Founded in 1897, it is a key national university under the direct administration of the Ministry of Education of China, and part of the national "Double First-Class", "Project 985" and "Project 211" initiatives. The university has more than 30 colleges covering philosophy, economics, law, education, literature, history, science, engineering, agriculture, medicine, management, art and other disciplines, with over 60,000 enrolled students.
ZJU boasts strong academic strength in engineering, computer science, agriculture, clinical medicine, materials science, chemistry, control science and other fields. It is ranked 44th globally in the 2026 QS World University Rankings.
